title: Maximum Energy Boost From Two Drinks
summary: Given two integer arrays representing the energy boosts per hour from two different energy drinks, you must maximize your total energy boost over n hours by drinking one drink per hour.
statement: Given two integer arrays representing the energy boosts per hour from two different energy drinks, you must maximize your total energy boost over n hours by drinking one drink per hour. Switching drinks requires a one-hour cleanse, during which no boost is gained. You can begin with either drink.
constraints: energy_drink_a and energy_drink_b have equal length n≥3 and contain positive boosts.
You may drink A or B in an hour; switching types requires one intervening hour with no drink.
You may begin with either type; return the maximum total boost.
hints: A schedule ending with A either also used A last hour or last used B at least two hours ago.
Keep best totals ending with each drink at every hour.
For A at hour i add its boost to max(A at i-1, B at i-2); use the symmetric recurrence for B.
Those two predecessor cases exhaust legal endings and preserve the best prefix, giving optimal substructure.

tests.explanation: Staying with either drink for all three hours yields five.
Drink A for four, cleanse for one hour, then drink B for three, totaling seven.
